title: Prognica Labs and Pinnacology Research & Development announce strategic partnership
summary: To advance novel intranasal anxiety therapy
thbAction: Position THB's pharma CRM and omnichannel HCP engagement workflows to support launch planning, KAM orchestration, and compliant follow-up across India and the Middle East.
contentHtml:
• Collaboration combines AI-driven drug discovery, pharmaceutical development and commercialization expertise to advance a natural-product-based intranasal microemulsion through a milestone-driven development program

DUBAI, UAE – Prognica Labs, a Dubai-headquartered AI-driven life sciences company, and Pinnacology Research & Development Pvt. Ltd., an India-based pharmaceutical research company, have announced a strategic co-development and commercialization partnership to advance an investigational intranasal microemulsion therapy for anxiety.

The collaboration aims to translate promising natural-product research into a scientifically validated pharmaceutical development program, combining Pinnacology's formulation research and technical expertise with Prognica's AI-enabled drug discovery platform, translational R&D capabilities, clinical development intelligence and international commercialization network.

Addressing a Significant Global Mental Health Challenge

Anxiety disorders represent one of the world's most prevalent mental health challenges. According to the World Health Organization (WHO), approximately 359 million people worldwide were living with anxiety disorders in 2021, highlighting the substantial need for accessible and effective treatment options.

The commercial opportunity is also significant. Industry market research cited in Pinnacology's development presentation estimates the global anxiety disorders treatment market at approximately US$12.3 billion in 2025, with projections reaching US$17.6 billion by 2035, representing an estimated compound annual growth rate of 3.6%.

Despite the availability of established therapies, important treatment challenges remain. Commonly prescribed antidepressants may require several weeks to achieve their full therapeutic effects, while certain fast-acting medications carry risks of sedation, dependence or withdrawal.

These limitations create an opportunity to investigate new therapeutic approaches that could potentially offer greater convenience, improved tolerability and clinically meaningful symptom relief.

Advancing a Differentiated Intranasal Therapeutic Platform

The proposed therapy combines naturally derived phytochemicals, including flavan-3-ols, with aromatic resin extracts in an intranasal microemulsion formulation.

The research identified potential interactions involving neurological targets such as MAOA, SLC6A4 and COMT and reported encouraging findings in preclinical behavioral studies.

The intranasal delivery strategy will investigate whether the formulation can achieve suitable drug exposure, acceptable nasal tolerability and a clinically useful onset of action.

The therapy remains investigational. Its safety, efficacy, speed of action and potential for direct nose-to-brain delivery have not yet been established in humans.

A Structured, Milestone-Based Development Partnership

Under the proposed collaboration framework, Prognica Labs will lead the development strategy, computational evaluation, coordination of preclinical and clinical research, regulatory planning, strategic fundraising and pharmaceutical commercialization activities.

Pinnacology will contribute its existing research, formulation expertise, scientific know-how and relevant intellectual-property rights, subject to verification and definitive agreements.

The partners intend to pursue a staged development program encompassing scientific and IP due diligence, formulation optimization, pharmacokinetic and toxicological assessment, preclinical proof of concept, regulatory readiness and subsequent clinical evaluation.

The collaboration will also explore funding through life sciences investors, strategic pharmaceutical partners and eligible research funding programs, with development activities financed against defined technical milestones.

 Building a Commercially Viable Pharmaceutical Asset

Beyond the research program, the partnership is designed to establish a pathway for long-term pharmaceutical commercialization, including potential co-development arrangements, regional and international licensing, and strategic partnerships with pharmaceutical companies.

India is expected to serve as an initial development focus, with opportunities for subsequent expansion into GCC and other international markets, subject to regulatory approvals and clinical validation.

The companies aim to create an asset-development model that integrates scientific innovation, capital-efficient research execution and international commercial partnerships.

About Prognica Labs

Prognica Labs is a Dubai-headquartered AI-driven life sciences company focused on accelerating pharmaceutical discovery and development. By integrating autonomous AI technologies, computational drug discovery, translational research, clinical intelligence and strategic commercialization, Prognica works to identify, evaluate and advance promising therapeutic assets.

Website: www.prognica.com

About Pinnacology Research & Development

Pinnacology Research & Development Pvt. Ltd. is an India-based pharmaceutical research and development company focused on innovative formulations and therapeutic research. Its investigational intranasal anxiety therapy program explores natural phytochemicals, aromatic extracts and advanced drug-delivery approaches.

Website: www.pinnacology.com
